name: Tasty Bite Eatables Limited
summary: Tasty Bite Eatables Limited manufactures and sells prepared food in India and internationally. The company offers ready-to-eat and ready-to-cook meals, sauces, frozen food, and culinary accompaniments for retail and foodservice customers. It also provides all-natural and organic entrees; organic rice; tomato-based sauces, gravy, curry, pastes, savory fillings, specialty sauces, and emulsion sauces; frozen-formed products, such as mixed vegetable, potato, paneer, cheese, plant-protein, and lentil burger patties, as well as plant-protein, mixed vegetable, potato, paneer, and cheese appetizers and finger food; and pasta and combo meals.
